description: Scan of all 81 Robinhood-tradable coins for the two WASHED SETUP shapes (daily uptrend + washed-out 5-minute tape): every hit with GO, fuel multiple vs BTC, grade and room, plus the setup column for the full universe. Recomputed about every 5 minutes, 24/7. Shapes were backtest-confirmed on equities and are forward-graded on crypto (disclosed per read). Paid per call via x402. $0.05 USDC per call (x402).
name: get_crypto_setups_live
